title: IELTS Vocabulary Practice - IELTS Vocabulary - Word Choice
subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: The findings of the research were ______; they did not prove the theory definitively.
questions.explain: 'Inconclusive' means not leading to a firm conclusion; not ending doubt or dispute.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: Buying a cheaper car is more ______ in the short term, but maintenance costs may be high.
questions.explain: 'Economical' means giving good value or service in relation to the amount of money, time, or effort spent. 'Economic' relates to the economy.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: The student gave a **coherent** presentation that was easy to follow.
questions.explain: 'Coherent' means (of an argument, theory, or policy) logical and consistent.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary
